A5_ladder_authority_declared: This registry is the SINGLE authority for every relation's resolution ladder, as identity-and-evidence section 3 states. `ladder` is that relation's total order over its OWN resolution methods, listed weakest-first, inherited verbatim from fact-plane.v1 relationRegistry.relations[].ladder (plus [observed] for unresolved-edge). Every other copy in the kit - native_evidence_model.v2.py LADDERS and capability-manifest-domains.v2.json RELATION-LADDER-DOMAIN-V2.ladders - is a declared MIRROR of this array and is drift-checked against it exactly and IN ORDER. A one-rung ladder is not a deficiency; it means the relation is fully determined at that rung.
